text.title: 玻璃旁的种子托盘
text.situation:
玻璃种植房比外面小径暖和。玛雅俯身看种子托盘，没有触碰。有些种子已开始发芽，细芽露出土面。露丝在标签上记录发芽日期。旁边空盆等着一株幼苗，等它长好后换种进大盆。植物要满足生长需要才会茁壮，并非进室内就能长好。

玛雅：每颗种子都发芽了吗？
露丝：还没有。看看日期，这些种得晚。
乔：何时重新种这株？
露丝：等它长到适合下一个盆时。我们看植株情况，不只看日期。

paragraphs.en: The conservatory was warmer than the path outside. Maya leaned over a seed tray without touching it. Some seeds had begun to germinate; thin shoots stood above the soil. Ruth had recorded the date of germination on each label. Beside the tray, an empty pot waited for a young plant. She would replant it in a larger pot once it was ready. The plants would thrive only if their needs were met, not simply because they were indoors.

paragraphs.en:
Maya: Has every seed germinated?
Ruth: Not yet. Look at the dates; these were planted later.
Jo: When will you replant this one?
Ruth: When it has grown enough for the next pot. We check it rather than follow a date alone.

S15.G04.P01.cue: 描述玻璃房和托盘里的东西。
acceptableAnswers: 玻璃种植房里有种子托盘。

S15.G04.P02.function: The seed tray by the glass
S15.G04.P02.cue: 说明标签日期记录什么过程。
acceptableAnswers: 它们记录发芽，即种子开始生长的时间。
